about_the_game:
• Three to the Point is an exciting turn-based puzzle game that combines platformer elements with strategic planning. In this indie game, you control multiple characters, each with their unique abilities. Constantly changing islands and challenging puzzles will require not only logic but also the ability to work with each move to find the optimal solution.

With every level you complete, new islands open up, filled not only with puzzles but also characters who introduce you to the world’s story. They’ll tell you about each corner, reveal its features, and sometimes even give you hints on how to overcome obstacles on your journey. It’s an adventure where it’s not only about solving problems, but also about enjoying every moment.

With bright and friendly visuals that appeal to both adults and children, the game creates an atmosphere where you can happily lose yourself while planning each step. Every detail is carefully thought out to make your journey exciting and comfortable. The game is perfect for family play, as it can be enjoyed together, discussing solutions and enjoying the process.

Take your time, think ahead, plan your moves, and uncover all the secrets in this unique and beautiful world. In Three to the Point, every move matters, and even the simplest actions can lead to unexpected outcomes:)

short_description: Small turn-based puzzle platformer with a unique twist — control multiple units and carefully position them to solve intricate puzzles. Each move matters, and every unit has a role to play. Think ahead, plan your turns, and uncover clever solutions in this compact but deeply strategic experience.
